title: Minimal stub component provides no value to users
reasoning: The RIAPortal component is a placeholder stub that only renders the text 'Portal'. This provides no meaningful functionality to users navigating to /ria. The route is publicly accessible (no authentication/gating visible in main.tsx:231) and labeled as a 'Generic template', yet it delivers no actual portal features, forms, or content.
reproduction: Navigate to /ria in the browser. Only the word 'Portal' appears with no interactive elements, styling, or functionality.
recommendation: Either implement a functional RIA portal with actual features (authentication, content, tools) or remove this route entirely if it's not needed. If this is intentionally a work-in-progress template, add a clear 'Under Construction' message and prevent external access until implementation is complete.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests are included for this feature. A rendering test would pass because the component does render without errors, but no test validates that the component provides expected portal functionality.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a test that verifies RIAPortal renders expected portal UI elements (e.g., navigation, authentication, or a meaningful message). Example: render(<RIAPortal />); expect(screen.getByRole('main')).toBeInTheDocument(); expect(screen.queryByText(/^Portal$/)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
